name: craggy-fatestone-rest-transform-two-buff
notes:
Craggy Fatestone (h8n1520m2d, GeneratedMacroCode.php activateAbilityAbilities/activateAbilityPrereqs["h8n1520m2d:0"]): "[Guo Jia Bonus] [REST]: Transform Craggy Fatestone. Activate this ability only if there are two or more buff counters on Craggy Fatestone." The 2 buff counters are seeded directly (setProperties) rather than accumulated via the card's OWN first clause ("Whenever an opponent materializes a card with memory cost 0, put a buff counter on Craggy Fatestone") -- this fixture still only exercises the second [REST]/transform clause and intentionally continues to seed its 2 buff counters directly, not the first clause. Verified live: activating transforms the card from h8n1520m2d into 40oe1wf79p (Obstinate Cragback). Break/restore verified: commenting out TransformCard() makes the fixture fail (stays as h8n1520m2d) and restoring it passes again.

ENGINE BUG (found, now FIXED): the first clause's implementation (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php, inside DoMaterialize()) was gated behind IsGuoJiaBonus($opponent) even though that restriction does not appear on the printed clause (only the second [REST] clause above is tagged [Guo Jia Bonus] in the card's own effect text). Separately and more significantly, DoMaterialize() only covers the from-material-zone / champion-lineage materialize path, NOT the ordinary from-hand materialize path (which resolves through MoveEffectStackCardToField instead and, before the fix, contained no equivalent Craggy Fatestone check) -- confirmed empirically that materializing an ordinary 0-memory-cost item (Fauna Friend, japulzj7gv) from hand via a normal FSM play never reached the check block, making the trigger effectively dead for the overwhelmingly common case.

Fixed by extracting the check into a shared CraggyFatestoneMaterializeTrigger($player, $memoryCost) helper (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php) with the IsGuoJiaBonus gate removed, called from both DoMaterialize() (from-material-zone path) and MoveEffectStackCardToField() (Custom/GameLogic.php -- the from-hand path). See the new craggy-fatestone-buff-counter-from-hand-materialize fixture, which positively demonstrates the fixed trigger firing unconditionally off a real from-hand materialize (no zone-seeding of the buff counter, no Guo Jia Bonus needed), with its own break/restore verification.

rulesClauses: [Guo Jia Bonus] [REST]: Transform Craggy Fatestone. Activate this ability only if there are two or more buff counters on Craggy Fatestone.
